$schema: clone-website extraction artifact — consumed by scripts/emit-design-system.ts
name: Adspirer

extraction.method: computed-style inspection, public CSS/font extraction, interaction sweep, and 1440px/768px/390px screenshots
extraction.evidence: Source captures are retained in docs/research/adspirer-com/raw. Values below were taken from root custom properties or computed live styles and cross-checked against full-page screenshots.
extraction.note: Light SaaS marketing system with a restrained neutral canvas, saturated blue action color, and a single orange display emphasis.

--bg.reason: Continuous page canvas behind hero, platforms, benefits, and pricing.

--surface.reason: Primary card, proof-band, and setup surface.

--surface-warm.reason: Segmented controls and quiet inset surfaces.

--fg-2.reason: Structured panel and guide text tier.

--muted.reason: Body supporting copy and secondary navigation color.

--border.reason: Default card edge and quiet division.

--accent.reason: Primary conversion button, selected tab, and main interactive signal.

--accent-on.reason: Readable foreground on saturated blue buttons and selected tabs.

--accent-hover.reason: Slightly deeper blue preserves the source press hierarchy.
--accent-hover.source: derived from --accent and observed CTA transition

--accent-active.reason: Deep blue present in the Ask AI gradient and pressed visual language.
--accent-active.source: source custom CSS Ask AI gradient

--warn.reason: Warm operational warning tier compatible with the orange source palette.

--danger.reason: Accessible destructive-state red, not a decorative page color.
--danger.source: OpenDesign semantic role calibrated to neutral palette

--font-display.reason: Downloaded Geist webfont is used for headings and display copy.

--font-body.reason: Downloaded Inter webfont is used for reading copy and controls.

--font-mono.value: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
--font-mono.reason: Endpoint and code examples need a legible technical fallback.

--text-xs.reason: Eyebrows, compact labels, and plan metadata.
--text-xs.source: computed social proof and pricing labels

--text-xl.reason: Phone section title tier and desktop minor display.

--text-2xl.source: computed platforms and Ask AI headings

--leading-body.reason: 24px body leading over the 16px base size.

--space-1.reason: Micro-label and compact icon gap unit.

--section-y-desktop.reason: Desktop section rhythm seen across the lower marketing page.

--section-y-tablet.reason: Interpolation between desktop and phone visual rhythm.

--section-y-phone.reason: Phone section rhythm retains deliberate empty space.

--radius-md.reason: Cards, menu, and workspace panel corners.

--radius-pill.reason: Billing picker, tabs, labels, and status dots.

--elev-flat.reason: Most cards use borders rather than depth.

--elev-ring.reason: Source panel outline expressed as a low-contrast ring.

--elev-raised.reason: Workspace panel’s distinctive deep soft shadow.

--focus-ring.reason: Clear blue keyboard ring aligned to selected control color.

--motion-base.reason: Source CTA hover transition uses half-second easing.

--container-max.reason: 1440px capture leaves 80px outer gutters around the main grid.

--container-gutter-desktop.reason: Main desktop content starts around x=80px.

--container-gutter-tablet.reason: Intermediate content gutter before phone compression.
